address: 5 Anhe East Road, Xitun District, Taichung, 407022, Taiwan
bio: The swanky setting seamlessly melds East-meets-West eclecticism with modern elegance. The chef team revisits Taiwan’s food heritage and culture, adding a sophisticated spin to family favourites. The Tasting Set Menu allows diners to pick from the main menu for each course, whereas the Chef’s Menu, served omakase style, needs pre-ordering. The iconic sweet Lukang roasted wheat flour soup is creatively mixed with almond milk imparting a creamy, nutty kick.
